collection: Ten individually source-checked public news references across Salt Lake, north Kolkata, Park Circus, Behala, Survey Park and the Hazra–Kidderpore transport corridor. Convenience sample; no complete city crime feed or independent street validation.
limitations: Incomplete news sample, with zero independently validated street incidents and zero current field observations. Locality bounds are deliberately broad research search areas, not incident locations, danger zones or administrative boundaries. Reports concern allegations; source checks do not prove an event. Private/campus/transport events and reports older than 365 days are excluded from default walking insights. Lack of a report never establishes safety.

sources.name: The Times of India · Kolkata reporting

reuse.terms: Linked public references and short original factual summaries only. No open dataset license or publisher partnership is claimed. Article text, photographs, victim identities and residential addresses are not redistributed.
